subject: Departure admin: Alex Jensen — pay, creds, and equipment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Alex Jensen — proposed end date and next steps

Monica / Laura,

I need to flag an employee departure that we should treat as an involuntary termination. Alex Jensen (SE, joined 2023-08) will be offboarded effective EOD 2026-07-02 pending HR finalization. Performance concerns documented in the attached summary; we've followed progressive steps and met with Alex last week.

Immediate asks:
- Can HR confirm standard severance for role level and any statutory requirements?
- Payroll: final paycheck timing and accrued PTO payout rules? Rachel, can you own payroll timeline?
- Security: quick access sweep on the afternoon of 7/2 (disable SSO, revoke GCP keys, remove from GitHub org).
- Assets: collect laptop, phone, and any vendor keys. Karthik will coordinate pickup.

I attached a short employee summary to provide context. I can handle the in-person conversation on Friday morning with Monica present. Please advise on severance draft and timing so I can set expectations.

Thanks,
Karthik
Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: employee_summary_alex_jensen.pdf (pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alex Jensen — proposed end date and next steps

Karthik — thanks for the heads up and the summary. I reviewed the notes and the timeline you shared. I'll prepare a standard severance offer consistent with level and tenure and route it for legal review. Draft will include continuation of benefits for 30 days and a confidentiality/waiver clause.

Quick clarifying questions:
- Final day for payroll purposes: 7/02 or do you want to set 7/01 as last paid date?
- Will Alex be on site Friday morning for the conversation? I prefer to do the conversation in person with you there and have the severance draft ready to share.
- Any access we should suspend immediately (e.g., VPN) or wait until after the conversation? My recommendation is to leave remote access until after the sit-down unless there's a security risk.

I'll attach the draft severance offer for internal review. Rachel, please confirm payout schedule and whether PTO payout requires a separate form.

Monica Patel
People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft_severance_offer_alex_jensen.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alex Jensen — proposed end date and next steps

Monica — thanks, that works. Notes:
- Alex will be on site Friday at 10:00 for the conversation.
- No immediate security red flags; he does not have admin keys. We can follow the post-meeting sweep unless you advise otherwise.
- Karthik ownership: I'll collect hardware and confirm serial numbers; I'll also exit him from on-call rotation today.
- Please include an item in the draft for outplacement counseling (we typically offer a session for SE level departures).

If you confirm the offer by EOD, I'll bring a printed copy to the meeting and ask Alex to sign where appropriate.

Karthik

Alex — thank you for meeting with Karthik and me this morning. As discussed, your last day with Redwood Inference will be July 2, 2026. Attached is the severance offer we discussed; please review and let me know if you have questions. Once you confirm, we'll route the offer via DocuSign for signature.

Action items and timeline:
- You will receive a DocuSign envelope today with the severance agreement. Please sign by 7/03 to confirm.
- Payroll will process final pay and accrued PTO on the next payroll run; Rachel will share exact date and amounts once she calculates.
- Security will perform an access sweep on 7/02 at 17:00 PT (SSO, GitHub, GCP access will be revoked at that time).
- Please return company laptop and phone to Karthik or drop at reception by 7/03. Karthik will confirm pickup details.
- Badge deactivation will occur after hardware receipt; I attached the badge deactivation request form for your reference.

If you need a referral or outplacement resources, we can share options — we'll include an outplacement voucher with the package.

Best,
Monica Patel
People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: draft_severance_offer_alex_jensen.pdf (pdf), badge_deactivation_request.form
